continuity: Baeksang is the great chieftain of the Bai people, one of Nanman's four most powerful great tribes.
Baeksang is Yayul Cheok's sworn younger brother and childhood companion; they fought together during the Great Faction War.
Yayul Mok is Yayul Cheok's only son for three generations, making Baeksang his father's sworn-brother uncle.
Baeksang and Yayul Cheok are deeply estranged; Baeksang has refused Yayul Cheok's fruit wine for decades.
Baeksang states that the Nanman Beast Palace will never join the Murim Alliance, citing the result of the previous tribal council.
The Fire Dragon Pavilion has been sent to its lodging to rest while Yayul Cheok and Baeksang discuss the alliance privately.
plot: A cold middle-aged man named Baeksang, the great chieftain of the Bai people, arrives to meet Yayul Cheok. Taekyung learns that Baeksang is Yayul Cheok's sworn younger brother and childhood companion, as well as Yayul Mok's sworn uncle. By baiting the irritable Yayul Mok with deliberately absurd questions, Taekyung confirms that Baeksang opposes the Nanman Beast Palace joining the Murim Alliance.

Baeksang privately refuses Yayul Cheok's fruit wine, as he has apparently done for decades, then declares that the Nanman Beast Palace will never join the Murim Alliance. The reason for his estrangement from Yayul Cheok and his cold scrutiny of Taekyung remains unknown.
translation_decisions: Render 백상 as Baeksang; treat White Elephant as the literal meaning of his name, not an alias.
Use sworn younger brother for the relationship between 야수묘왕 and 백상.
Render 강태공 as Jiang Taigong and 진드로 as Jindro.
Retain Great Chieftain for 대족장 and Murim Alliance for 무림맹.

active_continuity: The Fire Dragon Pavilion has been sent to its lodging after meeting Yayul Cheok, with further discussions pending.
Yayul Cheok personally welcomes Jin Taekyung as Jeok Cheongang's Disciple and receives the Fire Dragon Pavilion as Murim Alliance representatives.
Yayul Mok is Yayul Cheok's only son for three generations and serves as Young Palace Lord of the Nanman Beast Palace.
Baeksang is the great chieftain of the Bai people, one of Nanman's four most powerful great tribes.
Baeksang is Yayul Cheok's sworn younger brother and childhood companion; they fought together during the Great Faction War.
Baeksang and Yayul Cheok are now estranged, with Baeksang refusing Yayul Cheok's fruit wine for decades.
Baeksang declares that the Nanman Beast Palace will never join the Murim Alliance, following the previous tribal council's result.
Baeksang watches Jin Taekyung with cold scrutiny, but the reason for his interest is unknown.
open_questions: Why does Baeksang oppose joining the Murim Alliance despite his lifelong bond with Yayul Cheok and their shared service in the Great Faction War?
What is the meaning of Baeksang's cold scrutiny of Jin Taekyung?
Will Yayul Cheok be able to overcome the previous tribal council's opposition and bring the Nanman Beast Palace into the Murim Alliance?
Are the Bai people and other tribes aligned behind Baeksang's opposition?
Was the timing of the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau massacre connected to Dark Heaven's scheme?
temporary_decisions: Use Baeksang for 백상 and do not treat White Elephant as a separate alias.
Use sworn younger brother for 불알 동생 in the relationship between Yayul Cheok and Baeksang.
Use Jiang Taigong for 강태공 and Jindro for 진드로.
